visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a person's hand holding a dark blue iPhone 17 Pro Max. The hand slowly rotates the phone to showcase the large triple-lens camera module on the matte back. In the background, a crowd of people in a brightly lit indoor retail space can be seen, though they are out of focus. (2) The person flips the phone over to show the front screen, which is currently in the camera app's selfie mode. The screen displays the face of a man (the creator) wearing a yellow lanyard and a black t-shirt. The surroundings are reflected in the glossy screen bezel. (3) A thumb taps a specific icon on the lower left of the screen's camera interface. Immediately, the aspect ratio of the live camera feed on the screen shifts from a vertical rectangle to a wide, cinematic horizontal frame, despite the phone still being held vertically. The background remains the same bustling retail environment. (4) The scene transitions to a studio setting with a clean, light-colored background. The same man, now in a grey shirt, is seated behind a desk holding two iPhones in clear and grey cases. In front of him are several bitplay product boxes. He demonstrates a 3-in-1 strap accessory and a small green pouch that magnetically attaches to the back of the phone case. (5) The final phase shows three iPhones lined up, each in a different colored protective case (tan, grey, and black), highlighting the magnetic ring and stand feature on the back.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator, approximately 10 background visitors in the retail section.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male creator with short black hair, wearing a black t-shirt and yellow lanyard in the first half, and a grey crew neck sweater in the second half.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The first half is a bright, modern Apple-style retail environment with white tables and many people. The second half is a clean, minimalist studio with warm indoor lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy male speech at a fast rate, accompanied by a bright, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM with a strong kick-drum beat. Background crowd chatter is audible as a low-level murmur. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the speaker describes a new feature. The vocal pitch rises in excitement. (3) A subtle mechanical click and a digital UI 'ping' sound accompany the speaker tapping the phone screen to demo the horizontal selfie mode. The music maintains its driving rhythm. (4) The background atmosphere shifts abruptly from crowd murmur to studio silence as the scene cuts. The vocal quality remains high-fidelity but becomes more controlled and professional. (5) Light rustling of fabric and plastic occurs as the speaker handles a phone strap and a pouch. The music swells slightly in the final moments as the speaker delivers a promotional call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Demonstration -> Solution/Accessory Intro -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a unique horizontal selfie feature of the iPhone 17 Pro Max and leverage that interest to promote bitplay protective cases and accessories.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly introduces the brand bitplay, shows product packaging, demonstrates the accessories' functions, and provides a discount code.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-interest tech 'leak' or early review style hook to transition into a direct commercial sponsorship. The editing is optimized for social media engagement.
